title: Narrative marks
description: D112 (documentary plan, slice 7) — where the story turns and where it steps back in time, by beat id. Written by the narrative_marks stage; compile_plan places the film texture from it when style_pack.texture.placement is `narrative`: a light leak on the cut into a turn, the vintage grade over a flashback, a CRT set on a flashback's first footage. Decides no content.

flashback.description: beats told as a memory or a step back to an older time than the story around them

turns.description: beats where the story turns: a new place, time or chapter, a revelation. Always includes the script's paragraph starts after the hook (Dark Palace's rule)

source.description: model: the call answered; fallback: no answer, the turns are the paragraph starts and nothing is aged; off: the style pack places no narrative texture and no call was made

note.description: why the call gave no answer, when source is fallback
